scripts.test: sh -c 'TEST_DB_URL="${TEST_DATABASE_URL:-postgresql://portal:portalpw@localhost:5433/portaldev?schema=test}"; NORMALIZED_TEST_DB_URL=$(printf "%s" "$TEST_DB_URL" | tr "[:upper:]" "[:lower:]"); case "$NORMALIZED_TEST_DB_URL" in *"schema=public"*) echo "Refusing to run tests against schema=public. Set TEST_DATABASE_URL to a dedicated test schema." >&2; exit 1 ;; *"schema="*) ;; *) echo "Refusing to run tests without an explicit non-public schema in TEST_DATABASE_URL." >&2; exit 1 ;; esac; TEST_DATABASE_URL="$TEST_DB_URL" DATABASE_URL="$TEST_DB_URL" NODE_ENV=test prisma db push --skip-generate --accept-data-loss && TEST_DATABASE_URL="$TEST_DB_URL" DATABASE_URL="$TEST_DB_URL" NODE_ENV=test tsx --test --test-concurrency=1 src/**/*.test.ts'
